wb_new_lev: Commander... something just crossed the edge of the galaxy. The Leviathan. It's the season's finale, and everything we've built was for this.
wb_new_krk: The Kraken has risen from the deep layers. Eight arms, Commander, and it's the season's finale. Let's cut it down to size.
greet_mem_lev: We brought down the Leviathan. I still see its fire when I close my eyes... in a good way, I think.
greet_mem_krk: The Kraken's arms are still drifting out there, Commander. Every one we cut is a trophy.
wb_live_lev: A fleet is fighting the Leviathan right now. You have to see this.
wb_live_krk: Someone is wrestling the Kraken right now, arm by arm. Want to watch?
wb_fall_lev: The Leviathan has fallen! The finale is ours. If our fleets fought, the spoils are waiting.
wb_fall_krk: The Kraken is down! Every fleet that cut an arm gets a share of the spoils.

wblev: The Leviathan, Commander. A serpent of black scale and living fire, circling the very edge of the galaxy. Its scales shield it while they burn, so strike when it breathes and they cool.
wbkrk: The Kraken has come up from the deep layers. Eight armoured arms, and every one of them shields its body. Sever them one by one, and it's ours.

lev: Scanning the Leviathan. Burning coil, fire breath, tail scythe. Its scales burn, Commander. Strike when it breathes and they cool.
krk: Scanning the Kraken. Eight arms, a beak, and those eyes. Every arm we sever weakens its guard. Start cutting.

lev: It's older than the Wyrm, Commander. I can see it in its scales... it was out there before the stars we know.
Those aren't flames. That's its blood, burning through the cracks in its armour.
krk: Eight arms... and every one of them is longer than a fleet line.
Its eyes are looking right at us. Not at the ships. At us.

lev.t: The Serpent at the Edge of the World
lev.frag: …it circles where the stars end, and its fire is the last light before nothing. We did not make it. We built the walls so it would never turn inward…
lev.interp: A warden's log from the Architects' outer stations. The walls it mentions match the edge of the mapped galaxy: they were built to keep the Leviathan out.
lev.adv: They didn't build the galaxy's edge to keep us in, Commander. They built it to keep that out.
enc: Commander, something enormous is moving along the edge of the galaxy.
An Architect warden's log describes a serpent of fire, circling where the stars end.
It isn't drifting, Commander. It's patrolling.
def: The Leviathan is falling back into the outer dark.
The wardens wrote that it could never be killed, only turned away. Today, we turned it away.

krk.frag: …the lamps on the far shaft went out one by one, and where each had been there was a violet ring. Seal the deep levels. Whatever is down there has learned to count…
krk.interp: A mining guild's last report from the deep layers. The violet rings match the suckers on the Kraken's arms.
krk.adv: They sealed the mines and left. We don't have that option.
enc: Commander, the deep layers are going dark, one sector at a time.
A mining guild's last report speaks of violet rings, and lamps going out one by one.
Something down there has eight arms... and it's coming up.
def: The Kraken is sinking back into the deep layers.
The miners counted their lamps going out. This time, Commander, it was counting its arms.
